supersedes: The historical publication snapshot bound by PUBLICATION-SHA256SUMS.txt (committed snapshot 968c33569caef31910f393bb2e33e49476ea1bbf, prepared for a private repository).
scope: This inventory describes the sanitized PUBLIC tree of this repository only. The original project, submission package and pre-sanitization snapshot are preserved off-repository by the maintainer and are not redistributed here.

publicTree.note: Counts include this inventory, the checksum file and its detached digest.

checksums.covers: Every file in this sanitized public tree except PUBLIC-RELEASE-SHA256SUMS.txt itself and its detached digest file PUBLIC-RELEASE-SHA256SUMS.sha256 (the same two-file envelope pattern used by the historical publication checksums).
checksums.detachedDigest: SHA-256 of PUBLIC-RELEASE-SHA256SUMS.txt itself; the checksum inventory cannot contain its own digest.

thirdPartySoliditySources.reason: Captured third-party Solidity sources (BUSL-1.1, GPL-2.0-or-later, MIT headers, plus UNLICENSED deployment contracts in compiler inputs). Redistribution rights and license obligations could not be verified, so the copies and every compiler input/output embedding them were excluded.

compilerEvidenceEmbeddingSources.reason: Compiler input/output JSON artifacts embedding the same third-party sources.
compilerEvidenceEmbeddingSources.note: 86 compiler input/output and derived research files excluded. 22 project-authored chain-data records from the same directories were retained: 20 *-runtime.json bytecode records (public on-chain bytecode, block metadata, retrieval timestamps; same category as test/fixtures/runtime.json) and 2 independent-recompilation.json compiler-verification records (metadata only, personal paths redacted). The redacted recompilation records no longer match the hash pinned in src/oracle-assurance/reviewed.ts; the runtime correctly fails closed on such mismatches.

historicalEnvironmentCaches.reason: Reproducible historical TypeScript cache directories whose file paths embedded the maintainer username; not required to understand or run the project.

capturedWebsiteBodies.reason: Captured third-party website page bodies and extracted page text (Chainlink, Reservoir, Pharos, DexScreener). Redistribution permission not established.

historicalRecordsNote: SHA256SUMS.txt, PUBLICATION-INVENTORY.json, PUBLICATION-SHA256SUMS.txt and PUBLICATION-SHA256SUMS.sha256 are historical records of earlier snapshots. They are retained for provenance; PUBLICATION-SHA256SUMS.sha256 pins the pre-redaction bytes of PUBLICATION-SHA256SUMS.txt and therefore no longer matches the redacted historical file in this copy. The authoritative checksums for THIS tree are PUBLIC-RELEASE-SHA256SUMS.txt and its detached digest.
